metadata.question: Does Eastern Canada have higher carbon monoxide concentration on June 5th 2023 than June 1st 2023?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use Sentinel-5P TROPOMI CO (carbon monoxide) data - Collection: "COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_CO" - Date: June 1st, 2023 vs June 5th, 2023 (single days) - Location: Eastern Canada (approximate bbox: -80°W to -50°W, 45°N to 55°N) 2. Masking strategy: - Sentinel-5P has a quality assurance band (qa_value) - Should apply QA masking to filter out poor quality pixels - The CO band is 'CO_column_number_density' 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - CO concentration should be positive (>0) - Need to check if images exist for both dates - Need to check if valid pixels remain after QA masking - Compare mean CO values between the two dates - If June 5 > June 1, answer A; otherwise B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Eastern Canada region const easternCanada = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-80, 45, -50, 55]); // 2. Get CO data for June 1, 2023 const date1 = '2023-06-01'; const col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_CO') .filterDate(date1, '2023-06-02') .filterBounds(easternCanada) .select('CO_column_number_density'); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); console.log(`June 1 Images: ${size1}`); if (size1 === 0) { console.log('No data for June 1, 2023'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Get CO data for June 5, 2023 const date2 = '2023-06-05'; const col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_CO') .filterDate(date2, '2023-06-06') .filterBounds(easternCanada) .select('CO_column_number_density'); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`June 5 Images: ${size2}`); if (size2 === 0) { console.log('No data for June 5, 2023'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Process June 1 data const img1 = col1.mean(); const stats1 = img1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: easternCanada, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const mean1 = stats1.CO_column_number_density_mean; const count1 = stats1.CO_column_number_density_count; console.log(`June 1: Mean CO = ${mean1}, Pixels = ${count1}`); if (count1 === 0 || count1 === null) { console.log('No valid pixels for June 1'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 5. Process June 5 data const img2 = col2.mean(); const stats2 = img2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: easternCanada, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const mean2 = stats2.CO_column_number_density_mean; const count2 = stats2.CO_column_number_density_count; console.log(`June 5: Mean CO = ${mean2}, Pixels = ${count2}`); if (count2 === 0 || count2 === null) { console.log('No valid pixels for June 5'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 6. Validate and compare if (mean1 === null || mean2 === null || isNaN(mean1) || isNaN(mean2)) { console.log('Invalid calculation results'); console.log('C3'); return; } console.log(`Comparison: June 5 (${mean2.toFixed(6)}) vs June 1 (${mean1.toFixed(6)})`); if (mean2 > mean1) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
